items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: I look at the film I did on Fathead [Newman] which is just a very short thing. I think that’s beautiful because it captured Fathead.

ctx.x: I had no idea what to do but I was like so overwhelmed at that time with all these booms going all over the place and the place was overflowing. I remember we had to find another room and we fed a thing to the camera so these people could watch it. Like wow, this was fantastic.

Yeah, I love the Joe Williams film, and I love showing it. And to me, see you stopped working then but I didn’t. I was nervous, I was in the control room. And then we still had to edit and everything. But I’m very happy with what came out, though I look at it and I wish I had Joe for a longer period of time. We only had him for two days and there was a lot more things I would have liked to have gotten. But I think it works. But you know I look at the film I did on Fathead [Newman] which is just a very short…
Did you ever have moments where you are saying why am I doing this?
